# Picaro

> Picaro brings declarative evasion to Windows payloads. It takes a PE (or DLL /
> shellcode) and a YAML plan and emits a packed PE with the selected evasion
> techniques baked into a generated Rust stub.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/): what Picaro is and its authorized-use scope.
- [Getting started](/getting-started/): requirements, a first plan, and the build/run/measure commands.
- [Plan](/plan/): every block and field, plus the interactive wizard.
- [Examples](/examples/): the runnable plans, recipes and end-to-end tests.

## Loader features

- [Loader features overview](/features/): the stub-level configuration (not runtime steps) and the registry table.
- [syscalls](/features/ref/syscalls/): the syscall layer — none / Hell's Gate / Tartarus Gate / API hashing.
- [api_resolution](/features/ref/api_resolution/): the payload import proxy.
- [strings](/features/ref/strings/): build.stub.strings (xor / stack).
- [args](/features/ref/args/): build.payloads.<name>.args and PEB command-line patching.
- [Adding a feature](/features/adding-a-feature/): the metadata ritual.

## Architecture

- [How it fits together](/architecture/): the packer pipeline and repo layout.
- [Multi-stage plans](/multistage/): schema 6 `runtime:` — several payloads and living-off-the-land steps in one artifact.
- [Custom stubs](/custom-stubs/): replacing the builtin loader template.
- [Syscall layer design](/design/syscalls/): phases 6a/6b/6c, the resolvers and the trampoline.
- [API resolution design](/design/api-resolution/): the payload import proxy (catalogue, phases, limitations).
- [Polymorphism](/design/polymorphism/): on-by-default per-build code diversity (seeded codegen profile + per-build immediates), plus the planned premium layers (PE cosmetics, self-encrypting loader, LLVM obfuscation).
- [x86 support](/x86/): `build.output.arch`, what is ported and what is still x64-only.

## Reference

- [Measurements](/measurements/): phase-by-phase static/dynamic results and the EDR report.
- [Host programs](/hosts/): loading a packed DLL from a JVM, CPython, .NET, `rundll32` and more.
- [Process hollowing evidence](/techniques/process_hollowing/): measured behavior and remaining work.

## Notes

- The canonical sources are the Markdown files in docs/ plus
  src/techniques/*/README.md, src/features/*/README.md, README.md and
  examples/README.md.
- `docs/nav.yml` holds the navigation; the per-technique and per-feature pages, the
  plan reference and the examples page are generated from those files by the
  Starlight build (docs/site/scripts/assemble-docs.mjs).
- The site is built with Astro + Starlight. The links above are
  site-root-relative paths in the generated site.
